items.text: Uba lilalela ilizwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, ligcine kuhle yonke imilayo yayo engililaya yona lamuhla, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu izaliphakamisa phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zomhlaba.
Lezizibusiso zonke zizakuba phezu kwenu, zehlele kini, nxa lilalela ilizwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Lizabusiswa emzini, libusiswe futhi ensimini.
Kuzakubusiswa inzalo yenu, lezithelo zomhlaba wenu, lenzalo yezifuyo zenu, lokwanda kwenkomo zenu lezimvu zenu.
Kuzakubusiswa isitsha senu lomganu wenu wokuxovela izinkwa.
Lizakubusiswa ekuhambeni kwenu konke.
Izitha zenu ezilivukelayo iNkosi izakuzinqoba phambi kwenu; zizakuphuma ukulihlasela ngandlelanye, zibaleke ngezindlela eziyisikhombisa.
INkosi izakuthuma isibusiso sayo phezu kwenu, eziphaleni zenu lakukho konke elizakukwenza, ilibusise elizweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu elinika lona.
INkosi izakulimisa libe ngabantu abangcwele, njengokufunga kwayo kini, uba ligcina imilayo yayo, lihambe endleleni zayo.
Bonke abantu basemhlabeni bazakubona ukuthi libizwa ngebizo leNkosi, balesabe.
INkosi izakulandisela izinto ezinhle, inzalo yenu, lenzalo yenkomo zenu, lezithelo zomhlaba wenu, elizweni iNkosi eyafunga kubokhokho benu ukulinika lona.
INkosi izakulivulela indlu yayo yenotho ephezulu, ilinise izulu elizweni lenu ngesikhathi salo, ibusise wonke umsebenzi wezandla zenu; lizakweboleka izizwe ezinengi, kodwa lingeboleki lutho kuzo.
INkosi izakulenza libe yinhloko, lingabi ngumsila; lizakuba ngaphezulu, lingabi ngaphansi, uba lilalela imilayo yeNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu engililaya yona lamuhla, liyigcine kuhle.
Lingaphambuki lakwelilodwa lamazwi engililaya wona lamuhla, ukuya ngakwesokunene langakwesokhohlo, lingalandeli abanye onkulunkulu ukuze libakhonze.
Kodwa uba lingalaleli ilizwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, lingagcini kuhle yonke imilayo yayo lazo zonke izahlulelo zayo engililaya zona lamuhla, leziziqalekiso zonke zizakuba phezu kwenu zilehlele.
Lizaqalekiswa emzini, liqalekiswe futhi ensimini.
Kuzaqalekiswa isitsha senu lomganu wenu wokuxovela izinkwa.
Kuzaqalekiswa inzalo yenu, lezithelo zomhlaba wenu, lokwanda kwenkomo zenu lezimvu zenu.
Lizakuqalekiswa ekuhambeni kwenu konke.
INkosi izakuthuma phezu kwenu iziqalekiso lenhlupheko lenkathazo kukho konke elizakukwenza, lize libhubhe liphele masinyane, ngenxa yezenzo zenu ezimbi ngoba lingidelile.
INkosi izalinamathelisa isifo, lize liphele elizweni elingena kulo ukulithumba.
INkosi izakulitshaya ngofuba, langomkhuhlane, langokuvuvuka komzimba, langokutshisa okukhulu, langendlala, langokuhanguka, langengumane; konke lokhu kuzakulixotsha lize libhubhe.
Isibhakabhaka ngaphezu kwenu sizakuba lithusi, lomhlabathi ngaphansi kwenu ube yinsimbi.
INkosi izakuphendula izulu elina elizweni lakini libe ngumsizi lothuli, kwehlele phezu kwenu kuvela phezulu, lize libhubhe.
INkosi izakukwenza unqotshwe yizitha zakho; uzakuphuma ngandlelanye ukuzihlasela, uzibalekele ngezindlela eziyisikhombisa; uzakuba yinto eyesabekayo kuyo yonke imibuso yomhlaba.
Isidumbu sakho sizakuba yikudla kwezinyoni zonke zaphezulu lokwezinyamazana zasemhlabeni, kungabi khona muntu ozixotshayo.
INkosi izakukwehlisela amathumba aseGibithe, lamaqhubu, loqweqwe, lenkomo, elingelakwelatshwa kukho.
INkosi izakukwehlisela ubuhlanya lobuphofu lokudideka kwengqondo,
uphumputhe emini njengesiphofu siphumputha emnyameni, ungaphumeleli ekuhambeni kwakho; ucindezelwe kuphela, uphangwe njalonjalo, kungabi khona muntu okusizayo.
Uzalobola umfazi, omunye umuntu alale laye; uzakwakha indlu, ungahlali kuyo; uhlanyele isivini, ungakhi izithelo zaso.
Inkabi yakho izahlatshwa phambi kwakho, ungayidli; ubabhemi wakho athathwe ngodlakela phambi kwakho, angabuyiselwa kuwe; izimvu zakho zinikwe izitha zenu, kungabi lamuntu okusizayo.
Amadodana lamadodakazi akho azakunikelwa kwesinye isizwe, lamehlo akho azakufiphala ngokuwalindela langokuwakhalela insuku ngensuku; izandla zakho kaziyikuba lamandla okusiza.
Isizwe ongasaziyo sizakudla izithelo zomhlaba wakho lokwemisebenzi yonke yezandla zakho. Uzakucindezelwa kuphela, uchotshozwe njalonjalo,
uze uhlanyiswe yizinto amehlo akho azibonayo.
INkosi izakukutshaya emadolweni lasemilenzeni ngamathumba amabi ongelakwelatshwa kuwo, kusukela enyaweni zakho kuze kube sekhanda lakho.
INkosi izalinikela lina lenkosi yenu elayibeka ukulibusa esizweni elingasaziyo lina labokhokho benu, likhonze lapho abanye onkulunkulu abenziwe ngesigodo langelitshe.
Lizakuba yinto eyesabekayo, lesiga, lehlazo phakathi kwabantu bonke lapho iNkosi izakulisa khona.
Lizakuhaza inhlanyelo enengi ensimini, livune okuyingcosana kuphela, ngoba kuzadliwa yisikhongwane.
Lizakuhlanyela izivini, lizihlakulele, kodwa kaliyikunatha iwayini, kaliyikubutha izithelo zazo, ngoba imihogoyi izakuzidla.
Kuzabuka khona izihlahla
kulo lonke ilizwe lakini, kodwa kaliyikugcoba lina ngamagcobo azo, ngoba izithelo zazo zizakuvuthuka.
Lizakuzala amadodana lamadodakazi, kodwa kawayikuba ngawenu, ngoba azakuthunjwa.
Zonke izihlahla zenu lezithelo zomhlaba wenu zizakudliwa yisikhongwane.
Owemzini ohlala phakathi kwenu uzakuphakama phezu kwenu njalonjalo, lina lehlele phansi njalonjalo.
Yena uzakuleboleka, lingameboleki; yena uzakuba yinhloko, lina libe ngumsila.

Zonke leziziqalekiso zizakwehlela phezu kwenu, zixotshane lani, zilifice, lize libhubhe, ngoba kalilalelanga ilizwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, kaligcinanga imilayo yayo lezahlulelo zayo eyalilaya zona.
Zizakwehlela phezu kwenu laphezu kwenzalo yenu kokuphela zibe yisibonakaliso sokwahlulelwa kukaNkulunkulu.
Njengoba lingayikhonzanga iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu ngokuthokoza langenhliziyo ejabulayo ngenxa yobunengi bempahla yenu yonke,
lizakukhonza izitha zenu iNkosi ezakuzithuma kini ukulihlasela, lilambe, lome, lihambeze, liswele zonke izinto. Izakubophela entanyeni yenu ijogwe lensimbi, ize ilibhubhise.
INkosi izalithumela isizwe esivela khatshana emkhawulweni womhlaba ukulihlasela, sifike ngejubane lokhozi, isizwe elingalwaziyo ulimi lwaso,
isizwe esesabekayo, esingahloniphi abadala, esingelamusa kwabatsha.
Sizakudla amathole enkomo zenu lezithelo zomhlaba wenu, lize libhubhe; kasiyikulitshiyela amabele, lewayini, lamagcobo, lamankonyane enkomo zenu, lamazinyane ezimvu zenu, size silichithe.

Sizakulivimbezela kuyo yonke imizi yenu, ize idilike kulo lonke ilizwe imiduli yenu ephakemeyo leqinileyo elithembela kuyo; sizakulivimbezela emizini yenu yonke kulo lonke ilizwe lakini iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu elinike lona.
Ekuvinjezelweni lasekuhluphekeni kwenu elizakwehliselwa yizitha zenu lizakudla abantwana benu, inyama yamadodana leyamadodakazi enu iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu alinike wona.
Umuntu obuthakathaka lototoziweyo phakathi kwenu kayikunika umfowabo ukudla, lomkakhe othandekayo, labantwana bakhe abaseleyo;
ngitsho kayikubanika inyama yabantwana bakhe abadlayo, ngoba engaselalutho ngenxa yokuvinjezelwa lokuhlupheka izitha zenu ezizakwehlisela phezu kwayo yonke imizi yenu.

Owesifazana obuthakathaka lototoziweyo phakathi kwenu obengelasibindi sokunyathela phansi, ngoba ebuthakathaka kakhulu, njalo etotoziwe sibili, uzakwalela indoda yakhe ethandekayo, lendodana yakhe, lendodakazi yakhe,
ukuba badle umnakwabo ophuma kuye kanye labantwana azakubazala; ngoba uzakubadla ensitha ekusweleni kwakhe, ekuvinjezelweni lasekuhluphekeni izitha zenu ezizakulehlisela khona.
Lilo 4:10
Uba lingagcini kuhle wonke amazwi alumlayo alotshiweyo ogwalweni lolu, ukuba lesabe lelibizo elilodumo lelesabekayo lokuthi: INkosi uNkulunkulu wenu;
iNkosi izakulehlisela labantwana benu inhlupheko ezimangalisayo, ezinkulu lezingelakuphela, lemikhuhlane emikhulu lengelakuphela.
Izakuphinda ukwehlisela phezu kwenu zonke izifo zaseGibithe elizesabayo, zinamathele kini,
kanye lazo zonke izifo lezinhlupheko ezingalotshwanga ogwalweni lwalumlayo, lize libhubhe.
Lanxa belingangenkanyezi zaphezulu ngobunengi, lizasala seliyingcosana, ngoba kalilalelanga ilizwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Njengalokhu iNkosi ibithaba ngokulenzela okuhle langokulandisa, ngokunjalo izakujabula ngokulichitha langokulibhubhisa, lisuswe elizweni elingena kulo ukulithumba.

INkosi izakulihlakazela phakathi kwabantu bonke, kusukela komunye umkhawulo womhlaba kuze kube komunye, likhonze lapho abanye onkulunkulu abenziwe ngesigodo langelitshe, elingabaziyo lina labokhokho benu.
Phakathi kwalezozizwe kaliyikuba lokuthula kanye lendawo lapho lingabeka khona inyawo zenu; kodwa lapho iNkosi izakulipha inhliziyo ethuthumelayo lamehlo afipheleyo lomphefumulo ohluphekileyo.
Ukuphila kwenu kakuyikuba leqiniso; lizakutshaywa luvalo emini lebusuku, lingabi lethemba lokuphila.
Ekuseni lizakuthi: Kungathi kungahlwa! kusihlwa lithi: Kungathi kungasa! ngenxa yokwesaba okuzakwehlela kini langenxa yezinto elizakuzibona.

INkosi izakulibuyisela eGibithe ngemikolo, ngendlela engatsho ngayo ukuthi: Kalisoze liyibone futhi. Lapho lizazama ukuzithengisa ezitheni zenu ukuba libe yizigqili lezigqilikazi, kodwa kakho ozakulithenga.
